verdict.stance: Neutral / High-ROE Israeli Mortgage Champion with Tight CET1 Cushion (A-/BBB+)
verdict.summary: Israel's 3rd-largest bank (>36% mortgage market share) generated 17.1% adjusted ROE in 9M26 (NPAT NIS 4.03bn reported / NIS 4.6bn adj.), sector-leading 35.3% Q3 cost-to-income, and pristine 0.82% NPLs (6bp CoR). Tight 10.10% CET1 alongside 50% dividend payout and +11.4% YoY loan growth requires capital discipline ahead of 2031 T2 reset.

positives: Dominant >36% Israeli mortgage market share driving resilient 17.1% adjusted ROE (15.0% reported) and 35.3% CIR.
Pristine asset quality: 0.82% NPL ratio and ultra-low 6bp quarterly credit loss ratio.
Granular retail deposit funding (NIS 468bn, +11.1% YoY vs NIS 436bn loans).
negatives: Lean 10.10% CET1 cushion relative to rapid +11.4% YoY loan growth (+18% business lending) and 50% dividend payout.
Sovereign/geopolitical exposure and 2026-2027 special Israeli bank tax levy.
Real estate & mortgage concentration risk in domestic Israeli economy.

background.business_overview: Israel's third-largest commercial bank (~$187.8bn total assets) and undisputed national leader in residential mortgages (>36% share).
background.asset_perimeter: Israeli retail/mortgage banking (incl. Union Bank acquisition integration) and growing corporate/business lending.
background.ownership_governance: Widely held on TASE (MZTF; Wertheim/Ofer anchor groups); BoI D-SIB.
